parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, typically small and flat for easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to dispense liquid by pressing down, which activates the pump mechanism to release the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and bottle neck, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal pump components and provides structural support for the pressing lid.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers motion from the pressing lid to the internal pump.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of PET plastic, cylindrical in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid or gel to be dispensed and provides stability for the entire structure.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and serves as the reservoir for the liquid.
